children: The number of people registering as jobless in Spain rose by 1.81% in October from a month earlier, or by 43,128, leaving a total of 2.42 million people out of work, data from the Labour Ministry showed on Wednesday.

Spain gained 186,612 net formal jobs in October, the largest increase for the month of October in the historical series, bringing the total to 22.62 million jobs on a calendar-adjusted basis and excluding seasonality, the highest number of employed people on record, a separate report from the Social Security Ministry showed.
